name: Rejection Reason 88 Code
definition: Specifies the reason why the instruction/cancellation request has a rejected status.

DCAN.name: Rejected Since Already Cancelled
DCAN.definition: Cancellation request was rejected since the instruction has already been cancelled.

DPRG.name: Rejected Since In Progress
DPRG.definition: Cancellation request has been rejected because the instruction process is in progress or has been processed.

DUPL.name: Duplicate Instruction
DUPL.definition: Instruction is rejected due to duplicate business message identifier.

ECMD.name: Election To Counterparty Market Deadline Missed
ECMD.definition: Received after the election to counterparty market deadline.

ECRD.name: Election To Counterparty Response Deadline Missed
ECRD.definition: Received after the election to counterparty response market deadline.
